    LargeIndecomposable.AR.Directing.extVanish_pred

    Extensions of predecessors by a directing module split #

    If M is directing and U is an indecomposable predecessor of M (a path U → ⋯ → M of nonzero non-isomorphisms between indecomposables), then every short exact sequence 0 → M → E → U → 0 splits (Directing.extVanish_pred; ASS IX.1.4, first step). Otherwise some summand Eⱼ of E gives a path M → Eⱼ → U, and with U → ⋯ → M a cycle through M.
